_help: Fill these in to switch things on; leave empty to keep Nikki's email-draft behaviour, then run site-src/publish.sh. form_endpoint: hosted form service (Formspark: https://submit-form.com/FORM_ID). course_endpoint: optional, for the two email-course forms (defaults to form_endpoint). luma_url: office-hours event page. booking_url: applies to any [data-book] link (none on the pages yet).

messages.contact: Thank you. Your message has reached us and we will reply by email.
messages.booking: Thank you. We have your booking request and will email you to confirm your place.
messages.course: Thank you, you are on the list. Day one arrives when the course opens.
messages.failed: Sorry, that did not send. Please email us at info@paidiaconsulting.com.

_help_course: For MailerLite (recommended newsletter tool): course_endpoint = the action URL of your MailerLite embed form (https://assets.mailerlite.com/jsonp/ACCOUNT/forms/FORM/subscribe), course_field_names = {"email": "fields[email]"}, course_extra_fields = {"ml-submit": "1", "anticsrf": "true"}, course_no_cors = false (its endpoint allows cross-site replies, so failures show). Test with a dummy address first.
